descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații
Key Responsibilities
 End-User Support: Provide first and second-level technical support to end users (on-site and remote)
 Windows Administration: Manage and troubleshoot Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server environments
 Active Directory: Administer Microsoft Active Directory — user/group accounts, GPOs, and authentication
 Network Services: Troubleshooting DNS and DHCP services
 VPN Support: Support and troubleshoot VPN connectivity for remote users
 Microsoft 365 & Teams: Administer Office 365 and Microsoft Teams accounts, licenses, and configurations
 Ticketing: Track and resolve incidents and service requests using the Request Tracker (RT) platform
 Asset Management: Maintain and update the IT asset inventory covering hardware and software lifecycle
 Vendor Relations: Serve as the primary contact for communication with IT partners, vendors, and suppliers
 Projects & Documentation: Participate in IT projects and maintain procedures, solutions, and knowledge base articles
 Email accounts: Create, track the live time and management of the email accounts and distribution lists.
